variants.name: Cod with Prawns & Vegetables 85 g
variants.about_this_item: Monge Natural Superpremium BWild Grain Free Cod with Shrimp and Vegetables (green beans and carrots) is a complete and balanced food for adult cats. Specially formulated for your cat's well-being by choosing alternative, grain-free, carbohydrate sources derived from vegetables such as green beans and carrots. Shrimp is a source of high biological value protein and the food formula has been enriched with xylo-oligosaccharides (XOS), a new generation of prebiotics that support proper intestinal function. It contains Yucca Schidigera extract, which reduces faecal odours .
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Codfish (26%), pork liver, chicken meat, shrimps (4%), fresh carrots (2%), dried tomato pomace, dried green beans 1% (equal to 4.3% of fresh green beans), minerals, hydrolysed animal protein, xylo-oligosaccharide (XOS 0.1%), yucca schidigera (0.1%), spirulina.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein: 9.5%, Crude fibre: 0.5%, Crude fat: 5.5%, Crude ash: 2.6%, Moisture: 79%.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES: Vitamin D3 168 IU/kg, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl-acetate) 26 mg/kg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.01 mg/kg) 0.005 mg/kg, Manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 2.25 mg/kg) 0.73 mg/kg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 10.5 mg/kg): 8.4 mg/kg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 0.9 mg/kg) 0.22 mg/kg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 7.5 mg/kg) 2.46 mg/kg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 0.12 mg/kg) 0.08 mg/kg, taurine 400 mg/kg.

variants.name: Buffalo with Vegetables 85 g
variants.about_this_item: Monge Natural Superpremium BWild Grain Free Buffalo with Vegetables (green beans and carrots) is a complete and balanced food for kittens and adult large breed cats. Specially formulated for your cat's well-being by choosing alternative, grain-free, carbohydrate sources derived from vegetables such as green beans and carrots. Salmon oil increases the fat content and supports the normal development of the neurological system. The food recipe is enriched with xylo-oligosaccharides (XOS), a new generation of prebiotics that support proper intestinal function. It contains Yucca Schidigera extract, which reduces faecal odours .
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Buffalo meat (26%), chicken meat, pork liver, fresh carrots (2%), salmon oil (1%), dried tomato pomace, dried green beans 1% (equal to 4.3% of fresh green beans), minerals, hydrolysed animal protein, xylo-oligosaccharide (XOS 0.1%), yucca schidigera (0.1%), spirulina.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein: 11%, Crude fibre: 0.5%, Crude fat: 6.5%, Crude ash: 2.6%, Moisture: 79%.
